title: GCD (Euclidean Algorithm)
description:
Given `n = 48` and `d = 36`, find the Greatest Common Divisor using the Euclidean algorithm. Print the GCD.

Euclidean algorithm: while d != 0, set n, d = d, n % d. The GCD is n when d is 0.

**Expected output:**
```
12
```
